function.name: report_block_evaluation
function.description: Report a retrospective, descriptive evaluation of an already-completed powerlifting block

summary.description: 2-4 sentence overall summary of how the block actually went

key_takeaways.description: What, in hindsight, made a difference in this block - stated as an observation about the block's data, never as advice for the future.

conclusion.description: Short closing statement on the block's outcome
